title: PyINE: A Framework for Scalable Elicitation and Oversight via Code Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.04737v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reasoning models can remain capable of solving a task while still defaulting to cheaper but misleading shortcuts. This creates a central oversight problem: when a model gives an answer with plausible but incomplete reasoning, can an overseer determine whether that output should be trusted? To study this problem, we introduce PyINE, a framework for scalable elicitation and oversight using instrumented Python programs as a verifiable execution substrate. In PyINE, programs define task environments, execution traces provide authoritative labels for outcomes and intermediate facts, and task variants can be generated mechanically rather than through static human annotation. We instantiate the framework in PyINE-v1, a first release built from nearly one million deterministic execution traces and over 500,000 matched LLM-generated code variants used for counterfactual evaluation. Using standard RL with verifiable rewards on cue-varied tasks

translated_title: PyINE：一个通过代码执行实现可扩展引导与监督的框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.04737v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：推理模型可以在保持解决任务能力的同时，仍然默认采用更廉价但具有误导性的捷径。这就产生了一个核心监督问题：当模型给出一个推理看似合理但不完整的答案时，监督者能否判断该输出是否值得信任？为了研究这一问题，我们提出了PyINE，一个以插桩Python程序作为可验证执行基底的可扩展引导与监督框架。在PyINE中，程序定义任务环境，执行轨迹为结果和中间事实提供权威标签，任务变体可以通过机械化方式生成，而无需依赖静态的人工标注。我们在PyINE-v1中实例化了该框架，这是首个版本，基于近一百万条确定性执行轨迹以及超过五十万个匹配的大语言模型生成代码变体（用于反事实评估）构建而成。在提示多变的任务上使用带可验证奖励的标准强化学习……
tldr: 该论文提出PyINE框架，利用插桩Python程序作为可验证执行基底，通过近百万条确定性执行轨迹和五十多万个LLM生成的代码变体，来研究推理模型依赖误导性捷径时的可扩展引导与监督问题。
en_tdlr: PyINE is a scalable elicitation and oversight framework that uses instrumented Python programs as a verifiable execution substrate, built from nearly one million deterministic execution traces and over 500,000 LLM-generated code variants to study the oversight problem of reasoning models relying on misleading shortcuts.
